blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robinhood “Robin” Padilla in the early hours of Saturday expressed frustration over the prolonged delay in the proposed North Luzon East Expressway, alleging that someone was demanding P100 million just to secure the project’s approval. During the Senate deliberations on the Department of Public Works and Highways’ (DPWH) proposed 2027 budget, Padilla questioned why the 200-kilometer expressway, which was approved in 2007 under the Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) scheme, had yet to receive a notice to proceed. “Tutal madaling araw na, mag-deretsahan na tayo.
